ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
function $(rule){
	return java.getElements(rule);
}
var tab_name="",v_list=[];
//获取所有线路❗️
tab=$('.nav-swiper@a')
for(i=0;i<tab.length;i++){
	//获取播放列表❗️
	list=$('.anthology-list-play')[i]
	list=list.select('li')
	//线路名称❗️
	tab_name=`${String(tab[i].text()).replace(/\d+$/,'')} (${list.length})`;
		for(j in list){
		 //获取播放链接和标题
		 text=list[j].text();
		 url=list[j].select('a').attr('href');
		 //java.log(text+url)
		 v_list.push(JSON.stringify({
			 text,url,tab_name
		 }))
	 }
}
v_list
</js>
